author: integrated_case_peer

scope_review.instruction: Full decision contract, layered communication, evidence-status distinctions, comparable displays, normative criterion ownership, source boundaries and complete audience translations read. Two full packages and eight complete solutions, teach-back and changed-input retention are supplied.
scope_review.case1: All policy nets, budget/benefit units, neighborhood decomposition and absent cost incidence checked. Global endpoint theorem follows from affine pairwise differences and finite maximum. Entire deterministic menu excludes lotteries/adaptation. Exact minimax regret B differs from highest-worst-net O; ties and strict thresholds distinguished. No probability inferred from a range.
scope_review.case2: Both state NPVs and every dated cash entry independently reconstructed. Common existing obligation appears in liquidity, not incremental NPV. Committed loan has zero PV only at stipulated 25% rate; expected-value objective is explicitly risk-neutral planning, not claimed market pricing. Full conditions, adverse floor equality, feasibility and owner triggers preserved in both audience versions.
scope_review.solutions: All eight answers read: full corrected committee memo; same-parameter chart values/ties; narrowed-range regret tie and explicit tie-breaker; actual replacement display/caption; fixed-contract changed-rate value; complete no-facility board revision; probability/scenario/CI correction; changed-probability correction notice and new transfer solution. All exact fractions independently derived.
scope_review.display: Inline original SVG coordinate mapping, negative values/zero and text labels/patterns checked against adjacent accessible table. This is source/coordinate inspection, not a claimed browser rendering audit.
scope_review.rubric_and_retention: 20-point weights sum correctly; open tasks require actual artifacts and explicit grading criteria. Teach-back and retention answers complete; no actual learner observation claimed.
scope_review.sources: Fresh full HKS three-page guide inspection retained, two bounded ONS accepted records reused with original date and unnamed original inspector honestly preserved. No newly inferred policy facts or teaching-effect claims.
scope_review.crossreferences: Canonical C09 dependency contract read while adjacent drafting; C04 and foundational present-value/decision concepts accepted. Root acceptance remains sequential.

proofs: Maximum over finite affine difference functions on a closed interval equals maximum of endpoint regrets.
Known-theta alternative rankings and every boundary tie derived by pairwise differences.
Discounted incremental cash-flow linearity and zero-PV financing at stipulated rate; liquidity separately follows dated ledger in each state.
Narrow-range and retention preferences proven over entire intervals, not only sampled scenarios.

result.scope: Full memos/displays/global proofs/eight answers/source scopes separately read; synthetic assumptions are not real policy, financing commitments or learner achievements.

limits: No canonical acceptance, actual financing, board action, observed teaching, universal method effect or current empirical evidence claimed.

resolved_findings.repair: Replaced only final continuation sentence with accurate linked Observed teaching and reflective practice.
